retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast duotone composition featuring a central figure split horizontally between two vibrant color fields with heavy, overlapping sans-serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring a woman in 1970s attire, rendered in a duotone style. The top half of the image is cyan-tinted, while the bottom half is magenta-tinted. Large, white, ultra-bold sans-serif text is centered horizontally, overlapping the color boundary.
coreVisualRelationships: Horizontal bisecting line between cyan and magenta fields
Subject's pose spans both color zones
Typography anchored to the horizontal color transition
High contrast between white text and saturated background
coreInvariants: Centralized human subject in period-specific clothing

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot of a female figure, centered, filling approximately 80% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The horizontal line dividing the cyan and magenta sections.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face in the cyan zone, move down to the bold white text, and follow the diagonal lines of the subject's sleeves.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the subject and large-scale typography occupy most of the frame.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cyan (top half) and Magenta (bottom half) as primary duotone filters.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep navy/black for shadows and hair details within the duotone mapping.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation with crushed blacks and bright white highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Tight kerning with occasional character overlap
characterSpecificRedesigns: The '7' features a sharp, straight diagonal
The '0' is a perfect geometric circle

composition.relationshipToImage: Overlays the subject at the waist/chest level

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in varying scales for primary and secondary text.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric '0' and sharp '7' construction.
Provides the necessary weight and modern-retro feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a medium shot of a person in 70s fashion. Apply a horizontal split duotone filter: cyan on the top half and magenta on the bottom half. Ensure high contrast with deep blacks.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, centered, white geometric sans-serif text in all caps. Position the text so it sits directly on the color split line.

verificationChecks: Is the color split perfectly horizontal?
Is the text ultra-bold and white?
Does the subject appear in a duotone style?

adjustableVariables: Color pair (e.g., Yellow/Blue instead of Cyan/Magenta)
mustRedesign: Avoid using thin or serif fonts
Do not use natural skin tones
Ensure the text is not transparent
postGenerationChecks: Check for color bleed across the horizontal split
Verify text legibility against the background
Ensure the subject's features are visible through the duotone filter
Confirm the font matches the geometric ultra-bold style
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject [Person in 70s attire] + Color [Cyan/Magenta Horizontal Split Duotone] + Typography [Centered White Ultra-Bold Geometric Sans-Serif]
